nodes.name: JL MAG Rare-Earth
nodes.description: Dual-listed (Shenzhen 300748.SZ / Hong Kong 06680.HK) Chinese sintered-NdFeB permanent-magnet maker; in 2025 upgraded its humanoid-robot magnetic-component R&D department to a dedicated business unit. Magnet output sits inside China's rare-earth export-licensing regime. Component-exposure candidate; not a confirmed humanoid BOM placement.

nodes.name: Shin-Etsu Chemical
nodes.description: Public Tokyo-listed (4063.T) maker of NdFeB (Nd-Fe-B) sintered rare-earth magnets (N Series) used in industrial servomotors and linear motors; operates Japan's large-scale rare-earth separation/refining and is building a heavy-rare-earth refinery to diversify supply off China. Component-exposure candidate; not a confirmed humanoid BOM placement.

nodes.name: Proterial
nodes.description: Private Japanese magnet/materials maker (ex-Hitachi Metals; renamed 2023 after a Bain Capital-led buyout) that pioneered and mass-produces NEOMAX Nd-Fe-B sintered magnets for motors, and mass-produces a heavy-rare-earth-saving grade that minimizes dysprosium/terbium. PRIVATE — no public ticker. Component-exposure candidate; not a confirmed humanoid BOM placement.

nodes.name: Regal Rexnord
nodes.description: Public NYSE-listed (RRX) motion-control group whose brands include Kollmorgen (and Portescap, acquired via the 2023 Altra deal). Kollmorgen frameless / direct-drive torque motors (TBM/KBM/TBM2G) target robot, cobot and humanoid joints. Component-exposure candidate; not a confirmed humanoid BOM placement.

nodes.name: maxon
nodes.description: Private Swiss precision-drive maker; its EC frameless DT torque motors and integrated High Efficiency Joint (HEJ) actuators explicitly target humanoids, quadrupeds and exoskeletons. (Also a hollow-cup/coreless micromotor specialist for dexterous hands.) PRIVATE — no public ticker. Component-exposure candidate; not a confirmed humanoid BOM placement.

evidence.title: JL MAG Rare-Earth upgrades humanoid-robot magnetic-component R&D to a business unit
evidence.summary: JL MAG formalized a dedicated humanoid-robot magnetic-component business unit in 2025, with initial mass-production capability — confirming a named merchant NdFeB magnet supplier targeting humanoid motors.
evidence.excerpt: The company has upgraded the humanoid robot magnetic component technology R&D department to the humanoid robot magnetic component business unit, with the company's CEO concurrently serving as the strategic coordinator for this business unit.
evidence.limitations: Trade-press (SMM) reporting of company disclosure; no stock ticker printed on this page (ticker 300748.SZ verified separately via exchange/financial data).

evidence.title: JL MAG Rare-Earth 2024 high-performance magnetic material blank output ~29,300 mt (+39.48% YoY)
evidence.summary: Quantifies JL MAG's scale as the top-ranked global REPM producer, sizing the magnet supply that the China export-licensing constraint gates.
evidence.excerpt: high-performance magnetic material blank production of about 29,300 mt, up 39.48% YoY, and high-performance magnetic material finished product sales of about 20,900 mt, up 37.88% YoY
evidence.limitations: Blank/finished-product volume is company-wide NdFeB (all end-markets), not humanoid-specific; basis = production/sales tonnage, asOf full-year 2024.

evidence.title: Shin-Etsu Chemical Neodymium (Nd) Magnet N Series — product page
evidence.summary: Vendor product page confirming Shin-Etsu makes NdFeB sintered magnets and lists industrial servomotors/linear motors among applications.
evidence.excerpt: The Shin-Etsu Neodymium (Nd) Magnet N Series, which is composed mainly of neodymium (Nd), iron (Fe), and boron (B)
evidence.limitations: Vendor marketing/product page (good for who-makes-what, weak for market structure); 'Industrial motors (servomotors, linear motors)' is listed as an application, not a humanoid-specific BOM claim.

evidence.title: Proterial NEOMAX Nd-Fe-B magnets — product page
evidence.summary: Vendor product page: Proterial pioneered and mass-produces NEOMAX Nd-Fe-B sintered magnets and a heavy-rare-earth-saving grade that minimizes Dy/Tb, for motors and actuators.
evidence.excerpt: we have succeeded in developing and mass-producing the high-performance, heavy rare earth-saving material, which minimizes the amount of heavy rare earth elements added, such as dysprosium (Dy) and terbium (Tb)
evidence.limitations: Vendor marketing/product page; heavy-RE-saving grade addresses Dy/Tb intensity, not a humanoid-specific BOM placement. Proterial is private (Bain-owned) — no ticker.

evidence.title: MP Materials restores US rare-earth magnet production at Fort Worth Independence facility
evidence.summary: Company IR: MP's Independence facility began trial production of sintered NdFeB magnets targeting ~1,000 t/yr from a late-2025 ramp — sizing thin ex-China magnet capacity.
evidence.excerpt: produce approximately 1,000 metric tons of finished NdFeB magnets per year, with a gradual production ramp beginning in late 2025
evidence.limitations: Company IR/newsroom; ~1,000 t/yr is a target/ramp figure (automotive-grade, GM-directed), not realized humanoid-magnet output; basis = planned annual finished-magnet capacity.

evidence.title: CSIS — Consequences of China's new rare-earths export restrictions (April 2025)
evidence.sourceName: CSIS (Center for Strategic and International Studies)
evidence.summary: Independent analysis sizing the single-source-region corner: China held ~99% of global heavy-REE processing through 2023, and in April 2025 imposed export-licensing on seven medium/heavy rare earths and magnets — the binding constraint on humanoid motor magnet supply.
evidence.excerpt: Until 2023, China accounted for 99 percent of global heavy REEs processing
evidence.limitations: Think-tank analysis (independent, citable for structure); the 99% figure is heavy-REE PROCESSING share through 2023 (basis = processing share, asOf 2023), distinct from finished-magnet output share.

evidence.title: Kollmorgen (a Regal Rexnord brand) frameless torque motors — robot/cobot joints
evidence.summary: Vendor page identifies Kollmorgen as a Regal Rexnord brand and states its frameless torque motors power nearly 1 million robotic joints/arms globally — a named merchant frameless-motor supplier for robot joints.
evidence.excerpt: Kollmorgen's frameless torque motors mobilize nearly 1 million joints and robotic arms across the globe.
evidence.limitations: Direct fetch returned HTTP 403; excerpt captured via search index, not an independent page fetch (sourceStatus paywalled_snippet). Vendor marketing claim ('nearly 1 million joints') is a vendor_claim, not independently audited; robot/cobot joints broadly, not a humanoid-specific BOM placement.

evidence.title: Moog direct-drive brushless DC frameless (pancake) torque motors
evidence.summary: Vendor page confirms Moog makes direct-drive brushless frameless (pancake) torque motors supplied as a frameless rotor/stator part set — a named merchant frameless-motor supplier.

evidence.title: maxon launches robotics drive portfolio — EC frameless DT motors + HEJ joints for humanoids
evidence.summary: Trade press: maxon's High Efficiency Joint actuators integrate motors from its EC frameless DT lineup and target humanoids/quadrupeds/exoskeletons — a named merchant frameless-motor + integrated-joint supplier for humanoids.
evidence.excerpt: The High Efficiency Joints integrate torque-dense electric motors from maxon's EC frameless DT motor lineup
evidence.limitations: Trade-press product announcement; HEJ is an integrated actuator (motor + gear + electronics), with the EC frameless DT motor as the merchant motor element. maxon is private — no ticker.
